overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to consider several dimensional variances and special permit applications, approving proposals for 100 Dartmouth Street, 76 Greenleaf Avenue, and 640 Boston Avenue while denying a variance for 289 Fellsway West. The board also approved previous meeting minutes and granted a continuance for 77 Shepard Road.

items.title: 289 Fellsway West Variance (Deliberation and Vote)
items.summary: The board deliberated on a variance petition to convert a single-family residence into a two-family home at 289 Fellsway West and voted to deny the request.

items.title: 100 Dartmouth Street Garage Variance
items.summary: The board approved a variance allowing the construction of a two-car garage within the required front yard setback on Wellesley Street.

items.title: 76 Greenleaf Avenue Special Permit
items.summary: The board granted a special permit for an accessory home occupation to operate a massage therapy service at 76 Greenleaf Avenue, subject to operating hour conditions.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board discussed potential AI-generated meeting minute formats and voted to approve the meeting minutes for March 27.

items.title: 77 Shepard Road Continuance Request
items.summary: The board granted the applicant's request to continue the variance hearing for a hot tub setback at 77 Shepard Road to April 24.

items.title: 640 Boston Avenue Variance Amendment
items.summary: The board approved an amendment to a prior variance condition, allowing ground-floor retail space at 640 Boston Avenue to be converted into a one-bedroom apartment.

items.title: 289 Fellsway West Variance Presentation
items.summary: The applicant presented a request for lot area and lot width variances to convert an existing single-family structure at 289 Fellsway West into a two-family dwelling.
